keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Nemanja Gudelj (Getafe).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Costinha (Brighton and Hove Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Getafe 0, Brighton and Hove Albion 0.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Luka Vuskovic replaces Lewis Dunk.
Jaouen Hadjam (Brighton and Hove Albion) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Getafe 0, Brighton and Hove Albion 1. Malick Yalcouyé (Brighton and Hove Albion) header from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Costinha with a headed pass.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Diego Gómez replaces Pascal Groß.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Maxim De Cuyper replaces Jaouen Hadjam.
Substitution, Getafe. Enes Ünal replaces Ramón Terrats.
Substitution, Getafe. Francho Serrano replaces Kiko Femenía.
Substitution, Getafe. Mario Martín replaces Orel Mangala.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Ibrahim Osman replaces Olivier Boscagli.
Delay in match (Brighton and Hove Albion).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Michael Svoboda (Brighton and Hove Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Georginio Rutter (Brighton and Hove Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Getafe. Borja Mayoral replaces Martín Satriano.
Johan Mojica (Getafe) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Matt O'Riley replaces Georginio Rutter.
Second Half ends, Getafe 0, Brighton and Hove Albion 1.
